domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions so the denominators match.
Tag in mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no denominator-matching conversion is performed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless a common-denominator conversion is also carried out.
Do not tag for normalizing a nonstandard mixed number or converting an entire quantity to an improper fraction when no denominator-matching step is involved.

skills.name: Rewrite quantities
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or nonstandard mixed number into an equivalent subtraction-ready form, including adding a zero fractional part, normalizing a mixed number, or converting to an improper fraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when one or more quantities are converted to improper fractions as the chosen setup for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for common-denominator conversion alone.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has begun because the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag for the arithmetic subtraction itself once the quantities are already in workable form.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once quantities are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and/or subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization, denominator matching, or conversion to improper fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator or rewriting forms before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping steps that adjust a whole and fraction before re-subtracting.
Do not tag for simplification or final formatting after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole part when needed to complete the subtraction and express the result in lowest terms or other appropriate final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into fractional units because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative or insufficient.
Tag when a fraction or mixed number is reduced to lowest terms after subtraction.
Tag when a result is expressed as a whole number, mixed number, or 0 by simplifying a zero fraction or combining the final parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for initial rewriting of quantities before subtraction when no borrowing is involved.
Do not tag for ordinary subtraction that does not involve regrouping and is not a simplification/final-expression step.
Do not tag for common-denominator conversion by itself.
